name: Russia–Ukraine
summary: Mass Russian drone strikes on 1 Nov caused nationwide power cuts; Kherson truce ended
state: Ukraine's air force said Russia launched 433 drones overnight into 1 Nov and 326 more during the day, and the energy ministry reported nationwide power outages, including in Kyiv. A local truce in Kherson region that ran from 27 Oct ended on 1 Nov, with Kyiv saying Russia refused an extension (RTÉ). Russia said a drone hit an industrial site east of Moscow on 1 Nov.
for_you: Travel to Ukraine is against FCDO advice. Energy and grain markets remain sensitive to the war.
rubric_hit: Mass strikes on energy infrastructure = Alert
